title: Smoked Haddock Croquettes
description: A French-inspired dish featuring smoked haddock, pilaf, and a crispy exterior. Perfect as a snack or appetizer.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the pilaf, smoked haddock, and grated croatian cheese (if using).
In a separate bowl, beat the eggs.
Add the flour to the egg mixture and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Add the egg batter to the pilaf mixture and mix until just combined.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small patties.
Dip each patty into the melted butter, coating both sides evenly.
Heat about 1/2 inch of melted butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry the croquettes until golden brown and crispy, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Serve hot with lemon wedges on the side.
